line_name: SERVICE DES TELECOMMUNICATIONS
purpose: The ministry's own IT unit: runs its information systems and networks and supports its staff's computing, combined with communication, telecommunications.
scope_basis: A ministry's own IT unit printed as a service line of its own in Annexe 6. It runs systems, which are in scope, alongside desktop support and equipment, which are not, and the annex prints no split by nature, so it is held partial under the in-house IT rule (2026-09-25). Its name also covers communication, telecommunications, which the line does not separate either.
amount_scale: thousands of ariary as printed - every table is headed *En Milliers d'Ariary* - stored here normalised to units
doc_locator: LFI 2025 (Loi n° 2024-025), Tome 2 *Document budgétaire*, Annexe 6 *Prévision Dépenses par service*, column LFI 2025, PDF p. 265, ministère 13, programme 009, 00 Budget Général, service 00-13-0-173-00000
notes: Thousands as printed: LFI 2025 129,410. Cross-foot: every Annexe 6 service sums to its budget, programme and ministry totals, and the ministries to the Annexe 4 grand total, in each column used (geometry parse, zero differences). Origin: Annexe 6 prints no financing split, but in this programme Annexe 4's external financing equals exactly the sum of its G-coded project services, so this operating service is domestically financed. Added 2026-09-25 under the in-house IT rule; the first sitting held Annexe 6's IT services out as overhead.
